mkm.text: Oba is the dryad of Life, one of the three sisters who together are Trostani, and in Murders at Karlov Manor she turns out to be behind the killings of Ravnica's guild leaders. During the invasion she took the corruption of Realmbreaker into herself, fighting it alone and hiding her pain even from her sisters.

Oba used pollen from flowers sprouted from Vitu-Ghazi's roots to put citizens in a fugue state and make them kill her targets anonymously, and she brainwashed Etrata into killing Zegana, which drew the detective Alquist Proft. She got away with the murder of Teysa Karlov and accidentally killed Kylox when he was in the way of an assassin she sent after Krenko.

At Vitu-Ghazi, Proft reveals Oba as the organizer, and she breaks her calm and admits she killed them because they deserved it. She accuses Krenko of hoarding, Zegana of experimenting with Phyrexian oil, and Teysa of being in league with the Phyrexians, though Vannifar and Etrata show Zegana and Teysa were working against the Phyrexians.

Oba incapacitates her sisters Cim and Ses, separates from them so that Trostani is no more, and attacks the guild leaders, drawing directly on the Ravnican Worldsoul. Kaya argues that a Ravnica that takes sides is no Ravnica, and Etrata, who had been playing dead, activates the second barrier ward anchor so the two can pin Oba.
Oba is bound, and Ses and Cim put her to sleep. Kaya chooses not to kill her, since it would be an execution, and Cim says the Guildpact has no way to sever Oba, who remains their sister.
